text:
jana: Follow-up from INC-345 postmortem: recurring cache-eviction pattern. Need owners, short timelines, and specific runbook/playbook edits. Prefer async updates here.
sasha: I can write the playbook paragraph for "repeated evictions" and include the pager template.
evan: I'll own the canary rollout and verification checklist. Proposal: canary next Monday (5% traffic), verify 7 days, then full rollout.
maya: I'll take the runbook PR + config diff and add exact triage/rollback commands. Target: PR in 48h.
jana: Make the TTL change feature-flagged. Add a one-line revert command in runbook. Also add an explicit escalation: if same cluster has 2 eviction incidents in 10 days -> escalate to oncall-sre + oncall-platform and open a recurring-review ticket.
maya: Adding quick diagnostic commands to runbook now:
```
# eviction rate (last 10m)
curl -s "http://metrics.internal/query?expr=rate(cache_evictions_total[10m])"
# keys with lowest TTL
redis-cli -h cache.primary --raw keys "session:*" | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c 'printf "%s	" {} && redis-cli -h cache.primary ttl {}' | sort -k2 -n | head -n 15
```
evan: Rollout checklist I'll include: deploy to canary pool (5%), monitor 5m windows for evictions and p95 latency. Abort/rollback if evictions > 12/min OR p95 latency > +30% vs baseline. Will add kubectl snippets.
ops-bot: Created tasks INC-345-FU-X1 (owner: maya), INC-345-FU-X2 (owner: evan), INC-345-FU-X3 (owner: sasha). Links: https://tracker/INC-345-FU-X1, https://tracker/INC-345-FU-X2, https://tracker/INC-345-FU-X3
maya: Draft rollback commands for runbook:
```
# disable feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT_TOKEN" https://flags.internal/api/flags/ttl_experiment -d '{"enabled":false}'
# undo k8s rollout to last good revision
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/cache-proxy --to-revision=3
```
sasha: Playbook note: include sample pager payload and add automatic recurring-review creation when threshold is hit.
jana: Action recap and due dates:
- INC-345-FU-X1 (maya): runbook PR + config diff + triage commands (due in 48h)
- INC-345-FU-X2 (evan): canary rollout + monitoring checklist (canary next Mon)
- INC-345-FU-X3 (sasha): playbook escalation text + pager template (due EOD Fri)
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in in 5 days for INC-345-FU-X1.
jana: Thanks all. Reopen thread if blockers, otherwise we'll validate after canary. :white_check_mark:
